title: Health Charted Treatment Stack
description: Medications, supplements, therapies, and environmental modifications with mechanism and evidence tracking.

treatments.description: Canonical name source for medication and supplement references in other files.

type.description: medication, supplement, therapy, environmental modification, etc.

name.description: Canonical treatment name. Use this exact string in all other files.

brand_product.description: Specific brand and product name (e.g., 'Carlson Norwegian Cod Liver Oil')

timing.description: When during the day this is taken (e.g., 'morning with food', 'evening', 'before bed')

status.description: Legacy free-text status. Prefer 'lifecycle_status' for new entries.

lifecycle_status.description: Current state of this treatment. pending = framework-suggested, awaiting user commitment; planned = user-committed, not yet acquired; ordered = purchase placed, awaiting arrival; received = on hand, not yet started; active = currently in protocol; paused = temporarily suspended; discontinued = permanently stopped.

lifecycle_status_since.description: ISO date the current lifecycle_status began

lifecycle_status_notes.description: Free-text rationale or context for the current status

mechanism.description: How this treatment works at the biological level

monitoring.description: What to track and how often

interactions.description: Known or suspected interactions with other treatments

ingredient_amounts.description: Time-stamped snapshots of formulation contents. Use this array-of-objects shape for any per-date verification or ingredient list change. Never embed dates in field names (anti-pattern; see .claude/rules/data-shape-patterns.md).

date.description: ISO date the contents were verified or recorded

source.description: Where the values came from (label, manufacturer site, COA, third-party assay)

values.description: Map of ingredient name → amount with units (e.g., 'Vitamin_C': '1000 mg'). Open-ended; ingredients vary by product.
